sideA.text:
AN INCOMPLETE PLAN
We're putting together a plan to get into Utopia.
So far we know we'll need to find a way in.
The beginnings of your plan are on the back of
this card. You can't start it until you learn more.
Keep this card in the reserve between games.
P3-03a

sideB.text:

P3-03b
Expecting to collect it soon.

rules: Keep this card in the reserve between games.
The plan on the back cannot be started until a later instruction says more has been learned.
Letters A through E are blank steps on the plan. This card does not open them.
notes: Side A is P3-03a. Side B is P3-03b.
The five red letters are not the doors opened by the recon report. Those doors are 56 and 63.
Nothing on either side gives an action, an objective, or a search.
